8 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday evening.

The stories

  • Rochdale AFC faces Port Vale in a vital League Two match this Saturday Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC faces Port Vale in a crucial League Two match as both teams seek to improve their standings.
  • Gymbound to sponsor Rochdale Mayfield shirts for next two seasons Rochdale
    Rochdale Mayfield Rugby Club has secured a sponsorship deal with Gymbound, marking a significant partnership as the club approaches its 70th anniversary.
  • Patrick Whelan, 62, dies in roadside work incident in Rochdale Rochdale
    Patrick Whelan, a 62-year-old from Liverpool, has died following an incident at a roadside work site in Rochdale, remembered by family as a hardworking and jolly man.
  • Eight winners honoured at Rochdale Diversity Awards 2026 Rochdale
    The Rochdale Diversity Awards celebrated eight winners for their contributions to equality and community cohesion at a ceremony attended by over 350 guests.
  • Former police officer sacked for sharing confidential information with Rochdale drug dealer Rochdale
    Tubah Hamid, a former Tameside police officer, was dismissed after breaching confidentiality by sharing police information with her Rochdale drug dealer partner.
  • Rochdale AFC youth team eliminated from FA Youth Cup by Wigan Athletic Rochdale
    Rochdale AFC's youth team has been eliminated from the FA Youth Cup following a loss to Wigan Athletic in the first round.
  • Police appeal for help finding Kibriya Ahmed linked to missing children Rochdale
    Kibriya Ahmed, 42, is wanted after his two children were reported missing. He has connections to Rochdale and Manchester.
  • Police appeal for help in locating Kibriya Ahmed after his children reported missing Rochdale
    Kibriya Ahmed is wanted after his two children were reported missing. Police believe he may know their whereabouts.

Weather: Cloudy 14°C in Rochdale today.
